description: Phase 45 — Production Wiring, EWMA Correlation & Streak-Aware Sizing. userStories.title: EWMA Correlation Engine for Dynamic Portfolio Risk
userStories.description: New src/risk/ewma_correlation.py implementing exponentially-weighted moving average correlation tracking across FX pairs. Formula: Sigma_t = lambda * Sigma_{t-1} + (1-lambda) * r_t * r_t^T, lambda=0.94. Provides: (1) real-time correlation matrix, (2) diversification multiplier per pair vs portfolio, (3) correlation regime detection (RISK_OFF/RISK_ON/NEUTRAL), (4) pair clustering by correlation.
acceptanceCriteria: EWMACorrelationEngine class with update(returns_dict) and get_correlation_matrix() methods
Configurable lambda (default 0.94), min_observations (default 20)

detect_correlation_regime() returning RISK_OFF (high avg corr > 0.6), RISK_ON (low < 0.3), NEUTRAL
get_correlated_pairs(pair, threshold=0.7) returning list of correlated pairs
Atomic JSON persistence for correlation state
Pure Python + numpy only
At least 30 unit tests covering all methods and edge cases
userStories.notes: 75 tests passing. 604-line module with EWMA covariance→correlation conversion, diversification multiplier D=1/sqrt(1+avg_corr), correlation regime detection, pair clustering. Thread-safe with RLock. 3 factory functions.

userStories.title: Streak-Aware Anti-Martingale Sizing Overlay
userStories.description: Add streak detection and anti-martingale sizing as an overlay on AdaptivePositionSizer. After consecutive wins, gradually increase position (x1.3 per win, cap at 2x). After consecutive losses, decrease (divide by 1.8 per loss, floor at 0.3x). Integrates with the composite sizing as an additional multiplier.
